content.en:
Apple's September event will take place on Wednesday, September 9 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. Apple will announce its 2026 iPhone lineup, and this year is a big one. Along with the slab-style iPhones we've been using for years, Apple is going to debut its first foldable device. We'll also get new Apple Watches, a new set of AirPods, and possibly some other surprises.
Everything we expect to see at the "Surprise and Shine" event is below.
Foldable iPhone
Apple's 2026 iPhone lineup will include its first foldable device. We don't know what Apple will call it, but rumors suggest it might be named the iPhone Ultra.
Apple has designed a book-style foldable that has an iPad-like layout when it's opened up. It will have a ~5.5-inch OLED outer display, which is what you'll use when the iPhone is closed. It will unfold into a larger OLED display that's approximately 7.8 inches.
The design is wider than it is tall when it's open, and you can picture it as something like an iPad mini that folds in half. Samsung's recent Galaxy Z Fold8 matches the foldable iPhone rumors, so it may be the best look at the size and layout of Apple's device.
Apple wanted a crease-free design, but that doesn't seem to be possible with a foldable yet. The iPhone Ultra will instead have a minimal crease and a durable liquid metal hinge. Foldables are delicate and hinges can be a weak point, so Apple focused on durability. Rumors indicate Apple could have some tricks to keep the crease less visible over time, such as optically clear adhesive that will fill in any micro-cracks caused by repeated folding.
When unfolded, the iPhone Ultra could be as thin as 4.5mm, making it Apple's thinnest iPhone to date. That would make it 9mm when folded, which is close to the thickness of the 8.75mm iPhone 17 Pro Max. With a chassis that thin, Apple had to make design compromises.
There is reportedly no space for the TrueDepth camera system for Face ID, so it's going to use Touch ID instead. There will be a Touch ID side button, similar to the iPad Air and iPad mini. Though Face ID isn't included, there will be front cameras for both the inner and outer displays.
Apple also didn't have room for a three-lens rear camera system, so the iPhone Ultra won't have a telephoto lens. Rumors suggest it will have an Ultra Wide lens and a Wide lens located on the back of the device, so the rear camera works whether the iPhone Ultra is folded or unfolded.
It was unclear if MagSafe would be included because leaked dummy models didn't feature a magnetic ring, but Bloomberg says MagSafe charging will indeed be a feature.
The iPhone Ultra will have a 2nm A20 Pro chip. The A20 Pro is expected to be around 18 percent faster and up to 30 percent more power efficient than the A19 Pro, and it could have a 7-core GPU, a wider memory interface, and a larger L2 cache for its efficiency cores. We're expecting 12GB of RAM.
Apple's 2026 iPhones could use its house-designed C2 modem, which is expected to be faster and more efficient than the C1X. It's not yet clear if Apple has added mmWave technology to the C2, and if it hasn't, foldable iPhone models sold in the U.S. could use Qualcomm modems instead. mmWave 5G isn't widely used outside of the U.S., but it is an expected feature for U.S. iPhones. The other alternative is limiting the foldable iPhone to sub–6GHz 5G speeds worldwide.
Each half of the iPhone Ultra will have a battery inside, and it could have a total capacity in the 5,400 to 5,800 mAh range. The iPhone 17 Pro Max has a 5,088 mAh battery for comparison.
Apple isn't taking risks with color. The iPhone Ultra will come in silver/white and a second color that's been described as a very deep shade of indigo that's close to black.
Software could make or break the iPhone Ultra, and Apple has been telling developers to design their apps for a variety of sizes and aspect ratios to accommodate the two foldable screens. The iPhone Ultra is likely to support multitasking, side-by-side apps, and sidebars, much like the iPad.
Apple's first foldable won't be cheap. According to rumors, it will cost at least $2,000, and higher-capacity models could be upwards of $2,500.
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
The iPhone 18 Pro models will look a lot like the iPhone 17 Pro models, with no major design changes expected. There are rumors that the iPhone 18 Pro Max might be a little bit thicker and heavier because of a larger battery, but iPhone 17 Pro cases are expected to fit the iPhone 18 Pro models. The camera plateau could be slightly thicker to accommodate a new variable aperture lens.
Apple has new colors planned, including a dark cherry shade, light blue, and silver. Rumors suggest there won't be a black iPhone 18 Pro option.
With the iPhone 17 Pro models, there's a clear color contrast between the frosted glass back and the aluminum casing, but that might be more subtle with the iPhone 18 Pro. While the overall shape isn't being updated, the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max could have a smaller Dynamic Island. There were early rumors about under-display Face ID with no Dynamic Island at all, but that's not going to happen.
There may be a noticeable increase in battery life due to the larger capacity battery rumored for the 18 Pro Max (5,567 mAh), plus efficiency improvements from the 2nm A20 Pro chip it's supposed to get and an upgrade in display technology. Rumors say Apple is using an LTPO+ display that's more efficient than the current OLED display.
Apple plans to upgrade the main rear camera with a DSLR-like variable aperture, giving users more control over the light that reaches the lens. An option for a smaller aperture in bright lighting could improve exposure, while a larger aperture in lower lighting conditions would let in more light to reduce grain and produce sharper images. A variable aperture also gives more control over background blur. Some rumors suggest this might be a feature exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max, but it's not clear if that's accurate.
Apple could use a three-layer stacked image sensor developed by Samsung, which would make the camera more responsive and improve low-light performance. The Telephoto lens could have a wider aperture to let in more light, but no changes are rumored for the Ultra Wide lens or the front-facing camera.
There might be changes to the Camera Control button. Apple is supposedly simplifying it to eliminate the capacitive layer that lets you swipe to adjust camera settings on the button.
As with the foldable iPhone, some or all of the iPhone 18 Pro models could get Apple's C2 modem, but again, it's possible U.S. models will have Qualcomm modems for mmWave 5G.
Compared to the iPhone 17 Pro models, the iPhone 18 Pro models will be more expensive. Apple is paying more for memory and storage, and prices for Macs and iPads already went up. We could see a price increase ranging from $100 to $300.
Apple Watch Series 12
The Apple Watch Series 12 won't design changes, but Apple could bring back the ceramic case option. We're expecting an updated processor that could bring improvements to health and fitness tracking.
Apple is testing a feature that would let the heart rate sensor continuously collect data throughout the day, powering a new Health app feature that could show wellness-related info similar to what the Oura Ring offers.
Apple Watch Ultra 4
Like the Apple Watch Series 12, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will have no major changes. It's likely to get the same upgraded processor and related changes.
AirPods 5
References to AirPods 5 were found in the macOS 26.7 release candidate, and the new earbuds could launch alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. Apple could add an updated H3 chip for improved sound quality and lower latency, and we're likely to still get an ANC version and a non-ANC version.
Possible Product Launches
- Home hub - Apple is working on a home hub with a 7-inch square display, an integrated camera, presence detection sensors, and more. It will control smart home devices, but it will also run apps. Rumors suggest it can be used to make video calls, play content, and interact with Siri AI, the new version of Siri in iOS 27. Apple has been waiting to launch the home hub because Siri AI is a central feature of the new device.
- Apple TV 4K - There's a new Apple TV with a faster processor in the works, and it could come at the September event. No design changes are expected, but an updated chip could support Siri AI and new gameplay features. There are also signs of a new remote in Apple code.
- HomePod mini - The HomePod mini is due for a refresh, and it's also expected to get a faster processor. We haven't heard word of design changes, but it could come in new colors.
Software Updates
At the September 9 event, Apple will announce the release dates for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, tvOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. Apple will also likely seed release candidate versions of the updates to developers and public beta testers following the event.
Based on historical release timelines, iOS 27 and its sister updates could come out as soon as September 14.
What Not to Expect
There are several other products rumored to be launching before the end of 2026, but they'll likely come at a second event in October or November. There's also a notable omission from the lineup, because Apple is going to delay the iPhone 18.
- iPhone 18 - The standard iPhone 18 will not launch in September 2026, with Apple instead planning to debut it in spring 2027 alongside the iPhone 18e and the iPhone Air 2. In the fall, we're only getting the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and foldable iPhone.
- Apple Watch SE 4 - There won't be a new Apple Watch SE 4 this year.
- M6 MacBook Pro - A new entry-level MacBook Pro with an M6 chip is coming before the end of the year, but not at the September event.
- M6 iMac - There's also an M6 iMac rumored to be coming in 2026, but Apple is likely to hold a Mac event to announce it, or do it via press release at a later date.
- OLED MacBook Pro - We've been waiting on an OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro, and it's rumored for late 2026 or early 2027. It's not a candidate for Apple's September event.
- OLED iPad mini - There's an OLED iPad mini in development, and it's expected to launch before the end of October. It's another one that's unlikely for an iPhone event.
Apple's New CEO
New Apple CEO John Ternus has presented at Apple events before, but the iPhone event will be the first he hosts as CEO in place of Tim Cook.
Cook was Apple's CEO for 15 years, so a transition to Ternus leading an event is a major change.
Cook is now Apple's executive chairman, and he may not make an appearance during the event at all.
iPhone Preorders
Apple almost always holds preorders on the Friday after an event, but this year, that Friday is 9/11. It's unlikely Apple will do iPhone preorders on Friday because of the date, so orders could happen on Saturday instead. The last time iPhone preorders overlapped with the 9/11 date in 2015, Apple pushed orders to Saturday.
If Apple follows the same pattern, the iPhone 18 Pro models and the iPhone Ultra could be available for preorder on Saturday, September 12. Back in 2015, Apple started preorders at 12:01 a.m. Pacific Time, but in recent years, preorders have started at 5:00 a.m. Pacific Time. Preorders this year could take place at 5:00 a.m. on September 12.
The new iPhones will likely launch on Friday, September 18, regardless of preorder date.
How to Watch
Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event will start at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time on Wednesday, September 9. Apple will livestream the event on its website, on YouTube, and through the Apple TV app on supported devices.
For those unable to watch the livestream, MacRumors will have full event coverage on MacRumors.com and the MacRumorsLive X account. We'll also take a much closer look at all of the new products after the event.

رویداد سپتامبر اپل در روز چهارشنبه 9 سپتامبر ساعت 10:00 صبح به وقت اقیانوس آرام برگزار خواهد شد. اپل خط تولید آیفون های 2026 خود را معرفی خواهد کرد و امسال سال بزرگی است. همراه با آیفون‌هایی که سال‌ها از آن استفاده می‌کردیم، اپل قرار است اولین دستگاه تاشو خود را معرفی کند. ما همچنین اپل واچ های جدید، مجموعه جدیدی از AirPods و احتمالاً شگفتی های دیگر را دریافت خواهیم کرد.
هر آنچه که انتظار داریم در رویداد «سورپرایز و درخشش» ببینیم در زیر آمده است.
آیفون تاشو
مجموعه آیفون های 2026 اپل شامل اولین دستگاه تاشو خود می شود. ما نمی دانیم اپل چه نامی برای آن خواهد گذاشت، اما شایعات حاکی از آن است که ممکن است نام آیفون اولترا باشد.
اپل یک صفحه تاشو به سبک کتاب طراحی کرده است که وقتی باز می شود، طرحی شبیه به آی پد دارد. این یک صفحه نمایش بیرونی 5.5 اینچی OLED خواهد داشت که وقتی آیفون بسته است از آن استفاده خواهید کرد. این صفحه نمایش بزرگتر OLED تقریباً 7.8 اینچی باز می شود.
طراحی در حالت باز بیشتر از بلندی آن است و می‌توانید آن را چیزی شبیه به آی‌پد مینی تصور کنید که از وسط تا می‌شود. Galaxy Z Fold8 اخیر سامسونگ با شایعات آیفون تاشو مطابقت دارد، بنابراین ممکن است بهترین نگاه به اندازه و چیدمان دستگاه اپل باشد.
اپل طراحی بدون چین و چروک می خواست، اما به نظر می رسد که هنوز با یک تاشو امکان پذیر نیست. آیفون اولترا در عوض دارای حداقل چین خوردگی و یک لولای فلزی مایع بادوام خواهد بود. تاشوها ظریف هستند و لولاها می توانند نقطه ضعفی باشند، بنابراین اپل روی دوام تمرکز کرده است. شایعات حاکی از آن است که اپل می تواند ترفندهایی داشته باشد تا چین و چروک را در طول زمان کمتر دیده شود، مانند چسب شفاف نوری که هر ریز ترک ناشی از تا شدن مکرر را پر می کند.
زمانی که آیفون اولترا باز شود، ضخامت 4.5 میلی‌متر می‌رسد و آن را باریک‌ترین آیفون اپل تا به امروز می‌سازد. این باعث می‌شود هنگام تا شدن 9 میلی‌متر باشد که به ضخامت 8.75 میلی‌متری آیفون 17 پرو مکس نزدیک است. با یک شاسی به این نازک، اپل مجبور بود سازش هایی را در طراحی انجام دهد.
طبق گزارش ها، هیچ فضایی برای سیستم دوربین TrueDepth برای Face ID وجود ندارد، بنابراین به جای آن از Touch ID استفاده می کند. یک دکمه کناری Touch ID مشابه iPad Air و iPad mini وجود خواهد داشت. اگرچه Face ID شامل دوربین‌های جلویی برای نمایشگر داخلی و خارجی نیست.
اپل همچنین فضایی برای سیستم دوربین پشت سه لنز نداشت، بنابراین آیفون اولترا لنز تله فوتو نخواهد داشت. شایعات حاکی از آن است که این گوشی دارای یک لنز Ultra Wide و یک لنز Wide خواهد بود که در پشت دستگاه قرار دارد، بنابراین دوربین پشتی چه در iPhone Ultra تا شده باشد یا باز باشد، کار می کند.
مشخص نبود که MagSafe در آن گنجانده می‌شود زیرا ساختگی لو رفته است

title.en: Nvidia Wants to Turn Your Idle PCs Into a Personal Home Data Center With 'PAIR'
title.fa: انویدیا می‌خواهد رایانه‌های شخصی بیکار شما را با «PAIR» به یک مرکز داده خانه شخصی تبدیل کند

summary.en: Nvidia's PAIR links your unused laptops, desktops, and Macs together to run agentic AI locally without subscription fees or cloud privacy risks.
summary.fa: PAIR انویدیا لپ‌تاپ‌ها، رایانه‌های رومیزی و مک‌های استفاده‌نشده شما را به یکدیگر پیوند می‌دهد تا هوش مصنوعی عاملی را بدون هزینه اشتراک یا خطرات حفظ حریم خصوصی ابری اجرا کنند.

content.en:
Nvidia's latest offering isn't a flagship GPU or a giant AI model, but a free, open-source software tool called PAIR. Short for "Personal AI Router," it's a software tool that connects multiple computers in your home into a coordinated network, sharing computing resources to run local AI seamlessly. By making clustered computing a plug-and-play setup, Nvidia just gave local, private AI a massive power boost using devices people already own.
Solving a Problem You Didn't Know You Had
PAIR, announced at IFA 2026 in Berlin, solves a very particular issue: Running local AI is compute-intensive, requiring either a single ultra-powerful machine to run tasks sequentially or several machines running in parallel. As AI agents shift from niche to mainstream, this compute bottleneck will become more of a problem for more people.
PAIR solves this by converting the laptops and desktops that might be unused or idle in your home into a coordinated group of machines that can handle individual tasks, such as analyzing files, writing code, or organizing schedules.
This shift is crucial as agents start taking on personal and household tasks, and not simply business uses that can be localized on a powerful company-owned machine. Instead, this allows people and families to harness the power they already have in their home, and use it to handle sensitive information, personal files, and context data that you don't ever want to share with the cloud, or hand over to AI hosted elsewhere, where it becomes vulnerable to data leaks or misuse.
What PAIR Actually Does (and What It Doesn't)
PAIR is an AI router, meaning it acts as an intelligent traffic controller. It takes a single task or project, breaks it up into individual sub-tasks, and then assigns those smaller jobs to sub-agents on the different machines available on the home network. Breaking down these micro-workloads and running them in parallel across multiple devices, rather than queuing them to run one after another on a single machine, can dramatically accelerate complex jobs.
Just as important is what it's not doing. It's not pooling VRAM or splitting a single model across different systems, as you would when clustering two Nvidia DGX Spark boxes. Instead, it uses individual machines to handle complete, independent sub-tasks, routing each job to the system with the capacity, and orchestrating this across multiple tasks and machines. You give it one job to do, and PAIR manages the orchestration in the background to get it done.
What Hardware Works With PAIR?
One of the most surprising aspects of Nvidia's announcement is the cross-platform support it offers. Beyond AI-focused DGX Spark hardware running Linux, it's also built to work with Nvidia GeForce graphics cards on Windows and even Apple desktops and laptops running macOS.
A machine needs at least 8GB of RAM and 20GB or more of disk space, and the necessary hardware:
- Nvidia GeForce RTX 20 Series GPUs and newer
- Nvidia RTX PRO workstation GPUs
- Nvidia DGX Spark / GB10
- Apple M4 silicon or newer
Operating system support spans Windows 11, macOS Tahoe, Ubuntu, and DGX OS, and it works with both graphical and terminal interfaces. Plus, because PAIR works with your home network, it dynamically discovers compatible machines as they join or leave the network. It requires no special cables, server racks, or complex cluster setup. All of your prompts, files, and agent context stay entirely on your home network. After downloading the necessary models, it can even run with zero internet connectivity.
Nvidia's Big Play for the Home Data Center
As personal agents proliferate and new Nvidia hardware rolls out (such as the upcoming wave of RTX Spark laptops launching this fall), it's going to be more important than ever to have a usable way to leverage all that local AI power. Nvidia is pushing heavily to be the company that enables home-based AI compute, carving out an alternative to cloud subscription services.
It not only provides an incentive for more people to buy Nvidia hardware, but it also puts Nvidia at the center of the next big frontier for technology: the transition from manual app usage to autonomous, agentic computing, and AI that functions at the edge, in your home instead of in a distant data center.
In an era where users are increasingly wary of data privacy and monthly subscription fatigue, Nvidia is making a compelling case that the most powerful, secure, and cost-effective AI cluster is the one you already own.
If you want to try Nvidia PAIR yourself, it's free to download from Nvidia. Or watch a demo video showing it in use with a Hermes agent running 5-subagents in parallel.
About Our Expert
From the laptops on your desk to satellites in space and AI that seems to be everywhere, I cover many topics at PCMag. I've covered PCs and technology products for over 15 years at PCMag and other publications, among them Tom's Guide, Laptop Mag, and TWICE. As a hardware reviewer, I've handled dozens of MacBooks, 2-in-1 laptops, Chromebooks, and the latest AI PCs. As the resident Starlink expert, I've done years of hands-on testing with the satellite service. I also explore the most valuable ways to use the latest AI tools and features in our Try AI column.

آخرین پیشنهاد انویدیا یک پردازنده گرافیکی پرچمدار یا یک مدل غول پیکر هوش مصنوعی نیست، بلکه یک ابزار نرم افزاری رایگان و منبع باز به نام PAIR است. مخفف "Personal AI Router"، این ابزار نرم افزاری است که چندین کامپیوتر در خانه شما را به یک شبکه هماهنگ متصل می کند و منابع محاسباتی را برای اجرای یکپارچه هوش مصنوعی محلی به اشتراک می گذارد. انویدیا با ایجاد محاسبات خوشه‌ای یک راه‌اندازی plug-and-play، به هوش مصنوعی محلی و خصوصی با استفاده از دستگاه‌هایی که قبلاً مالک آن‌ها هستند، قدرت عظیمی را افزایش داد.
حل مشکلی که نمی دانستید دارید
PAIR که در IFA 2026 در برلین معرفی شد، یک مشکل بسیار خاص را حل می‌کند: اجرای هوش مصنوعی محلی محاسباتی فشرده است و به یک ماشین فوق‌العاده قدرتمند برای اجرای کارهای متوالی یا چندین ماشین نیاز دارد که به صورت موازی کار کنند. همانطور که عوامل هوش مصنوعی از جایگاه به جریان اصلی تغییر می کنند، این گلوگاه محاسباتی برای افراد بیشتری مشکل ساز خواهد شد.
PAIR این مشکل را با تبدیل لپ‌تاپ‌ها و دسکتاپ‌هایی که ممکن است در خانه شما بدون استفاده یا غیرفعال باشند، به یک گروه هماهنگ از ماشین‌ها تبدیل می‌کند که می‌توانند وظایف فردی مانند تجزیه و تحلیل فایل‌ها، نوشتن کد، یا سازمان‌دهی برنامه‌ها را انجام دهند.
این تغییر بسیار مهم است زیرا نمایندگان شروع به انجام وظایف شخصی و خانگی می کنند، و نه صرفاً استفاده تجاری که می تواند در یک ماشین قدرتمند متعلق به شرکت بومی سازی شود. در عوض، این به افراد و خانواده‌ها اجازه می‌دهد تا از قدرتی که قبلاً در خانه‌شان دارند استفاده کنند و از آن برای مدیریت اطلاعات حساس، فایل‌های شخصی و داده‌های زمینه‌ای که هرگز نمی‌خواهید با ابر به اشتراک بگذارید، استفاده کنند، یا به هوش مصنوعی که در جای دیگری میزبانی شده است، استفاده کنند، جایی که در برابر نشت داده‌ها یا سوء استفاده آسیب‌پذیر می‌شود.
PAIR در واقع چه کاری انجام می دهد (و چه کاری انجام نمی دهد)
PAIR یک روتر هوش مصنوعی است، به این معنی که به عنوان یک کنترل کننده هوشمند ترافیک عمل می کند. این یک کار یا پروژه واحد را می گیرد، آن را به وظایف فرعی جداگانه تقسیم می کند و سپس آن کارهای کوچکتر را به عوامل فرعی در ماشین های مختلف موجود در شبکه خانگی اختصاص می دهد. شکستن این ریز بارها و اجرای موازی آنها در چندین دستگاه، به جای قرار دادن آنها در صف برای اجرای یکی پس از دیگری روی یک دستگاه، می تواند کارهای پیچیده را به طور چشمگیری تسریع کند.
به همان اندازه مهم این است که چه کاری انجام نمی دهد. مانند زمانی که دو جعبه Nvidia DGX Spark را جمع می کنید، VRAM را ادغام نمی کند یا یک مدل را در سیستم های مختلف تقسیم نمی کند. در عوض، از ماشین‌های جداگانه برای رسیدگی به وظایف فرعی کامل و مستقل استفاده می‌کند، هر کار را به سیستم با ظرفیت هدایت می‌کند و این کار را در چندین کار و ماشین تنظیم می‌کند. شما به آن یک کار می دهید تا انجام دهد و PAIR ارکستراسیون را در پس زمینه مدیریت می کند تا آن را دریافت کند

title.en: 'This Move Reflects the Team’s Evolving Workplace Needs' — Bungie Confirms Plans to Sublease Parts of Its Enormous Bellevue Headquarters Following Mass Layoffs
title.fa: "این حرکت منعکس کننده نیازهای در حال تحول تیم در محل کار است" - Bungie برنامه های خود برای اجاره بخشی از دفتر مرکزی عظیم Bellevue خود را پس از اخراج دسته جمعی تایید کرد.

summary.en: Bungie has responded after announcing plans to sublease 210,984-square feet of its massive headquarters in Bellevue, Washington, saying this move reflects its continued focus on a “digital first” model.
summary.fa: Bungie پس از اعلام برنامه‌های خود برای اجاره فرعی 210984 فوت مربع از مقر بزرگ خود در Bellevue، واشنگتن، پاسخ داد و گفت که این حرکت نشان‌دهنده تمرکز مداوم آن بر مدل «اولین دیجیتال» است.

content.en:
Bungie has confirmed it is "exploring options" to sublease 210,984 square feet of its massive headquarters in Bellevue, Washington, saying the move reflects its continued focus on a "digital first" model.
Following major layoffs across Bungie’s team in June, the studio has made the decision to put a large chunk of its Bellevue headquarters up for sublease, meaning that it’ll be renting out parts of the space to a third party (or parties).
The Game Post broke the news after reportedly reviewing a 10-page advertisement for the building in a commercial leasing brochure, which stated that 210,984 square feet of the building will be available to sublease through September 30, 2035. That’s a long time from now, and one that left fans concerned for Bungie's future projects.
Bungie confirmed the news in a statement sent to The Game Post, stating that this move reflects the company’s growing focus on remote work, which ties into its "digital-first" model.
"Bungie is exploring options to sublease its campus in Bellevue, Washington," a studio spokesperson said. "The studio transitioned to a digital-first model several years ago, and this move reflects the team’s evolving workplace needs and the effectiveness of its remote collaboration. Bungie will continue to maintain a physical office presence in Bellevue."
Responses from the community have been mixed; some argue that this change is only logical, given the massive layoffs that just occurred, while others are about what this could mean for Bungie’s future.
"I’ve seen people dooming about this like it doesn’t make a ton of sense in the present circumstances," one wrote on X. "400-something people aren’t gonna be able to use that space in full, and it’s better than letting it collect dust."
"Bungie is so good at making games (imo) that I wish they could fill all this space and have 2-5 projects at once,” another said. “But with their reduced size now, it’s probably the wise decision."
"In layman's terms, 'We're all going to be working from home now, since we can no longer afford our massive offices,'" another remarked.
Bungie notably laid off 292 workers at its Bellevue, Washington office in June, marking its third round of layoffs in three years. As per reporting from The Seattle Times, this location employed 1,000 staff members in 2023; the company reportedly laid off approximately 320 employees between October 2023 and July 2024, making this most recent round of layoffs even more brutal.
This latest news follows growing discontent from Bungie’s fanbase, who recently took to the chat en masse during PlayStation’s September State of Play to spam requests for Destiny 3 after the developer ended support for the title in favor of focusing on Marathon earlier this year.
Sources told Forbes that plans were in place to 'relaunch' the game as Destiny Infinity, but they were ultimately scrapped. Destiny 3 was also reportedly considered by Bungie, but "things didn't swing that way."
Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze.
content.fa:
Bungie تأیید کرده است که در حال بررسی گزینه‌هایی برای اجاره فرعی 210984 فوت مربع از دفتر مرکزی عظیم خود در Bellevue، واشنگتن است و گفت که این حرکت نشان‌دهنده تمرکز مداوم آن بر مدل «اولین دیجیتال» است.
پس از اخراج‌های عمده تیم Bungie در ماه ژوئن، استودیو تصمیم گرفت بخش بزرگی از دفتر مرکزی Bellevue خود را برای اجاره فرعی قرار دهد، به این معنی که بخش‌هایی از فضا را به شخص ثالث (یا اشخاص) اجاره خواهد داد.
گیم پست این خبر را پس از بررسی آگهی 10 صفحه ای ساختمان در یک بروشور اجاره تجاری منتشر کرد که بیان می کرد 210984 فوت مربع از ساختمان تا 30 سپتامبر 2035 برای اجاره فرعی در دسترس خواهد بود. این مدت زمان طولانی از هم اکنون است و طرفداران را نسبت به پروژه های آینده Bungie نگران کرده است.
Bungie این خبر را در بیانیه‌ای که به The Game Post ارسال کرد، تأیید کرد و اظهار داشت که این حرکت نشان‌دهنده تمرکز فزاینده شرکت بر کار از راه دور است که به مدل "دیجیتال اول" آن مرتبط است.
سخنگوی استودیو گفت: "Bungie در حال بررسی گزینه هایی برای اجاره فرعی پردیس خود در Bellevue، واشنگتن است." این استودیو چندین سال پیش به اولین مدل دیجیتال تبدیل شد و این حرکت نشان دهنده نیازهای در حال تحول تیم در محل کار و اثربخشی همکاری از راه دور آن است. Bungie به حضور فیزیکی دفتر خود در Bellevue ادامه خواهد داد.
پاسخ های جامعه متفاوت بوده است. برخی استدلال می کنند که با توجه به اخراج های گسترده ای که به تازگی رخ داده است، این تغییر تنها منطقی است، در حالی که برخی دیگر درباره معنای این امر برای آینده Bungie هستند.
یکی از آنها در X نوشت: "من افرادی را دیده ام که در مورد این موضوع محکوم می شوند که انگار در شرایط فعلی چندان منطقی نیست."
یکی دیگر گفت: "Bungie در ساخت بازی (imo) آنقدر خوب است که ای کاش می توانستند همه این فضا را پر کنند و 2 تا 5 پروژه را همزمان داشته باشند." اما با کاهش اندازه آنها در حال حاضر، احتمالاً این تصمیم عاقلانه است."
یکی دیگر خاطرنشان کرد: «به زبان ساده، «همه ما در حال حاضر از خانه کار خواهیم کرد، زیرا دیگر نمی توانیم دفاتر عظیم خود را بپردازیم».
Bungie در ماه ژوئن 292 کارگر خود را در دفتر Bellevue در واشنگتن اخراج کرد که سومین دور اخراج خود در سه سال گذشته بود. طبق گزارش سیاتل تایمز، این مکان 1000 کارمند در سال 2023 داشت. طبق گزارش‌ها، این شرکت تقریباً 320 کارمند خود را بین اکتبر 2023 و ژوئیه 2024 اخراج کرد که این دور اخیر اخراج‌ها را وحشیانه‌تر کرد.

title.en: Your older Pixel phone may finally be getting Quick Share AirDrop support
title.fa: ممکن است گوشی قدیمی Pixel شما بالاخره از Quick Share AirDrop پشتیبانی کند

summary.en: Your Pixel 7 or Pixel 8 looks like it's about to get AirDrop/Quick Share support, just like all the newer Pixel phones.
summary.fa: به نظر می‌رسد Pixel 7 یا Pixel 8 شما در شرف دریافت پشتیبانی از AirDrop/Quick Share است، درست مانند همه تلفن‌های Pixel جدیدتر.

content.en:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Your older Pixel phone may finally be getting Quick Share AirDrop support
Sep 4, 2026 — 1:30 PM ET
- Android picked up cross-platform Quick Share/AirDrop support last fall, but access has been limited to specific device models.
- On the Pixel front, that’s included phones from the Pixel 8a on up, but earlier today we learned of a possible expansion to the Pixel Tablet.
- We’re now also getting reports of Pixel 7 and Pixel 8 users seeing notifications of this new support.
Devices that won’t play nicely together suck. Sometimes incompatibility is the design goal, trying to lock you into one ecosystem or another. Other times it’s a glitch, or even just developer callousness. But however it starts, we’re always glad to see it come to an end. Android and iOS devices have been inching closer towards peaceful co-existence with the arrival of cross AirDrop/Quick Share support, and now it looks like a long-overdue expansion is taking place.
Google started bringing AirDrop compatibility to Quick Share on Pixel 10 phones last fall, eventually expanding that down through the Pixel 8a series. And while that list now also includes the new Pixel 11 family, we’ve been wondering when the rest of the Pixel crew might be invited to join the party.
Earlier today we shared with you the first report we’ve seen of the old Pixel Tablet adding AirDrop support, and now we’re already finding similar accounts from owners of Pixel 7 and Pixel 8 handsets.
Here, users @megumario on Telegram and @Cookieofautumn1 on X share the notifications they’re just now spotting on their Pixel handsets. This may be a phased rollout, so it’s possible you may not get this on your own device straight away, but be on the lookout.
It’s worth noting that while multiple users have seen these messages, at least some claim that it’s still not working for them, suggesting the notification may have been premature. Perhaps it’s also tied to specific software updates, which aren’t necessarily all arriving at the same time.
We’ve reached out to Google in an effort to get the full picture on this apparent expansion, including precisely which Pixel devices should be expecting to get this support. We’ll update this post with anything more we’re able to learn.

content.fa:
پیوندهای وابسته در Android Authority ممکن است برای ما پورسانت دریافت کنند. بیشتر بدانید.
ممکن است گوشی قدیمی Pixel شما بالاخره از Quick Share AirDrop پشتیبانی کند
4 سپتامبر 2026 - 1:30 بعد از ظهر به وقت شرقی
- اندروید پاییز گذشته پشتیبانی از Quick Share/AirDrop را از پلتفرم های مختلف دریافت کرد، اما دسترسی به مدل های دستگاه خاص محدود شده است.
- در قسمت جلویی Pixel، این شامل تلفن‌هایی از Pixel 8a به بالا می‌شود، اما اوایل امروز از یک توسعه احتمالی به Pixel Tablet مطلع شدیم.
- اکنون همچنین گزارش‌هایی از کاربران Pixel 7 و Pixel 8 دریافت می‌کنیم که اعلان‌های این پشتیبانی جدید را مشاهده می‌کنند.
دستگاه‌هایی که به خوبی با هم بازی نمی‌کنند، بد هستند. گاهی اوقات ناسازگاری هدف طراحی است، تلاش برای حبس کردن شما در یک اکوسیستم یا آن. در مواقع دیگر این یک نقص یا حتی بی‌احتیاطی توسعه‌دهنده است. اما هر طور که شروع شود، ما همیشه خوشحالیم که پایان آن را می بینیم. دستگاه‌های اندروید و iOS با ورود پشتیبانی از AirDrop/Quick Share به همزیستی مسالمت‌آمیز نزدیک‌تر شده‌اند، و اکنون به نظر می‌رسد که یک توسعه طولانی مدت در حال وقوع است.
گوگل پاییز گذشته شروع به ارائه سازگاری AirDrop به Quick Share روی گوشی‌های Pixel 10 کرد و در نهایت این قابلیت را از طریق سری Pixel 8a گسترش داد. و در حالی که این لیست اکنون شامل خانواده جدید پیکسل 11 نیز می شود، ما نمی دانیم که چه زمانی ممکن است بقیه خدمه پیکسل برای پیوستن به مهمانی دعوت شوند.
اوایل امروز اولین گزارشی را که از تبلت قدیمی پیکسل که پشتیبانی AirDrop را اضافه کرده بود با شما به اشتراک گذاشتیم، و اکنون در حال یافتن حساب‌های مشابه از صاحبان گوشی‌های پیکسل 7 و پیکسل 8 هستیم.
در اینجا، کاربران @megumario در تلگرام و @Cookieofautumn1 در X اعلان‌هایی را که اکنون در گوشی‌های پیکسل خود مشاهده می‌کنند به اشتراک می‌گذارند. این ممکن است یک عرضه مرحله‌ای باشد، بنابراین ممکن است فوراً آن را در دستگاه خود دریافت نکنید، اما مراقب باشید.
شایان ذکر است که در حالی که چندین کاربر این پیام‌ها را دیده‌اند، حداقل برخی ادعا می‌کنند که هنوز برای آنها کار نمی‌کند، که نشان می‌دهد ممکن است اعلان زودهنگام بوده باشد. شاید به به‌روزرسانی‌های نرم‌افزاری خاص نیز مرتبط باشد، که لزوماً همه در یک زمان به دست نمی‌آیند.
ما با Google تماس گرفته‌ایم تا تصویر کاملی از این گسترش آشکار به دست آوریم، از جمله اینکه دقیقاً کدام دستگاه‌های پیکسل باید منتظر دریافت این پشتیبانی باشند. ما این پست را با هر چیز دیگری که بتوانیم یاد بگیریم به روز خواهیم کرد.
از اینکه بخشی از جامعه ما هستید متشکرم. قبل از ارسال، خط مشی نظرات ما را بخوانید.

summary.fa: یک بلوک یونیکد که زمانی نادیده گرفته می شد و برای انسان نامرئی بود، روز به روز در حال استفاده گسترده تر است.

content.en:
A clever technique used to hide malicious prompts in attacks on AI agents has been adopted by spammers to evade filters on email platforms that are designed to flag unwanted messages used in mass campaigns.
The technique is broadly known as ASCII smuggling. It gained attention two years ago as a means of making a class of AI attack known as prompt injections more stealthy. Malicious instructions embedded in emails or other untrusted content to be processed by an LLM aren’t written in ordinary text. Instead, they’re rendered by a special range of Unicode tags. For example, the tag point U+E0041 mirrors “A,” and U+E0061 mirrors “a.”
No longer just for obscuring prompt injections
The block of 128 tags mimics a portion of the American Standard Code for Information Interchange almost perfectly, with one major difference: the characters they encode are readable by computers but, by design, are almost completely invisible to humans. By expressing the malicious prompts in these tags, LLMs detect the instructions, but people reading the email never see them. There’s much more about ASCII smuggling here.
Earlier this year, Microsoft started seeing a massive increase in spam messages that used the technique. Beginning on one day in early February, the number of ASCII smuggling signatures detected by Microsoft Defender for Office spiked from roughly 21,000 per day to more than 1.3 million. Within four days, signature detections jumped to 2.5 million. The deluge persisted for months and then fell off sharply in mid-May.
“Because tag characters are invisible to humans but exist at the text-processing level, the same property that makes them useful for smuggling instructions into a model also makes them useful for obfuscating keywords before a detector evaluates them,” Microsoft explained Thursday. “The intent is inverted, but the mechanism is similar, and a user’s suspicions are not raised.”
content.fa:
یک تکنیک هوشمندانه که برای پنهان کردن پیام‌های مخرب در حملات به عوامل هوش مصنوعی استفاده می‌شود، توسط ارسال‌کنندگان هرزنامه برای فرار از فیلترها در پلتفرم‌های ایمیلی که برای پرچم‌گذاری پیام‌های ناخواسته مورد استفاده در کمپین‌های انبوه طراحی شده‌اند، به کار گرفته شده است.
این تکنیک به طور گسترده به عنوان قاچاق ASCII شناخته می شود. دو سال پیش به‌عنوان وسیله‌ای برای مخفی‌تر کردن گروهی از حملات هوش مصنوعی معروف به تزریق‌های سریع مورد توجه قرار گرفت. دستورالعمل های مخرب تعبیه شده در ایمیل ها یا سایر محتوای غیرقابل اعتماد برای پردازش توسط LLM در متن معمولی نوشته نمی شوند. در عوض، آنها توسط طیف خاصی از تگ های یونیکد رندر می شوند. به عنوان مثال، نقطه برچسب U+E0041 منعکس کننده "A" و U+E0061 آینه "a" است.
دیگر فقط برای مبهم کردن تزریقات سریع نیست
بلوک 128 تگ تقریباً به طور کامل بخشی از کد استاندارد آمریکایی برای تبادل اطلاعات را تقلید می کند، با یک تفاوت عمده: کاراکترهایی که آنها کدگذاری می کنند توسط رایانه قابل خواندن هستند اما، از نظر طراحی، تقریباً برای انسان کاملاً نامرئی هستند. با بیان اعلان های مخرب در این برچسب ها، LLM ها دستورالعمل ها را تشخیص می دهند، اما افرادی که ایمیل را می خوانند هرگز آنها را نمی بینند. در اینجا اطلاعات بیشتری در مورد قاچاق ASCII وجود دارد.
در اوایل سال جاری، مایکروسافت شاهد افزایش گسترده پیام‌های هرزنامه‌ای بود که از این تکنیک استفاده می‌کردند. از یک روز در اوایل فوریه، تعداد امضاهای قاچاق ASCII شناسایی شده توسط Microsoft Defender برای Office از حدود 21000 در روز به بیش از 1.3 میلیون افزایش یافت. ظرف چهار روز تعداد امضاها به 2.5 میلیون رسید. سیل ماه ها ادامه داشت و سپس در اواسط ماه مه به شدت سقوط کرد.
مایکروسافت روز پنجشنبه توضیح داد: «از آنجایی که کاراکترهای برچسب برای انسان نامرئی هستند اما در سطح پردازش متن وجود دارند، همان ویژگی که آنها را برای قاچاق دستورالعمل ها به یک مدل مفید می کند، آنها را برای مبهم کردن کلمات کلیدی قبل از ارزیابی آنها مفید می کند.» "قصد معکوس است، اما مکانیسم مشابه است، و سوء ظن کاربر مطرح نمی شود."

images.alt: Volume holds at a low-thousands baseline through February 8, jumps roughly two orders of magnitude on February 9, peaks at over 2.3 million messages on February 11, and dips sharply on Sunday February 15 before rebounding.

The deep recurring drops are weekend pauses in the observed signature matches; the decline after May 15 marks the end of the high-volume phase matching this exact activity, followed by a low residual.

title.fa: مخالفت کلانتر میامی با طرح تبدیل شهر به سرزمین GTA

summary.en: The 'GTA x MDC' marketing event proposed by Miami-Dadeâs mayor has been criticized by both Miami-Dade's sheriff and its commissioner
summary.fa: رویداد بازاریابی «GTA x MDC» پیشنهاد شده توسط شهردار میامی داد، هم از سوی کلانتر میامی داد و هم از سوی کمیسر آن مورد انتقاد قرار گرفته است.

content.en:
Miami-Dadeâs sheriff, Rosie Cordero-Stutz, has publicly opposed plans to transform the city into a real version of Grand Theft Auto 6âs Vice City, as the âfictional worldâ of the Miami pastiche âincludes murder, robbery, drug trafficking, carjacking, violence against law enforcementâ and âother conductâ that the police department works âevery single day to prevent.â
As originally uncovered by The Miamian (via Rock Paper Shotgun) last week through a public records request, Miami-Dade mayor Daniella Levine Cava pitched a âGTA VI Ã MDCâ collaboration to Rockstar Games in June of this year.
The pitch, available here, outlines several ways in which Miami, described as âthe real-world inspiration for Vice City,â could be transformed using âapproved GTA VI characters or visual references.â There are some genuinely interesting ideas in here, like the proposed Vice City Motor Fest event, which would âcombine classic cars, customized vehicles, lowriders, motorcycles, tropical graphics, and local entertainment within a controlled, family-appropriate setting.â
While a spokesperson on behalf of Miami-Dade’s mayor stated that the GTA VI Ã MDC collaboration has yet to be “formally agreed to or approved,â Miami-Dadeâs sheriff has still challenged the planned marketing deal.
âGrand Theft Auto is a video game franchise built around criminal activity,â stated Sheriff Cordero-Stutz. âIts fictional world includes murder, robbery, drug trafficking, carjacking, violence against law enforcement, and other conduct that the men and women of the Miami-Dade Sheriffâs Office work every single day to prevent.â
As reported by the Miami Herald, Sheriff Cordero-Stutzâs comments were part of a joint statement from her and Miami-Dade Commissioner Juan Carlos Bermudez, a Republican candidate who is potentially set to oppose Mayor Levine Cava, a Democrat, in 2028.
âMiami-Dade County has spent decades building a reputation as a world-class destination for tourism, business, investment, and opportunity,â stated Bermudez. âWe should be promoting the Miami-Dade we have worked so hard to build, not a fictional version of our community defined by crime and violence.â
content.fa:
رزی کوردرو-استوتز، کلانتر میامی داد، علناً با طرح‌هایی که برای تبدیل شهر به نسخه واقعی Grand Theft Auto 6 Vice City مخالفت کرده است، زیرا «دنیای تخیلی» پاستیل میامی «شامل قتل، سرقت، قاچاق مواد مخدر، دزدی خودرو، خشونت علیه پلیس برای انجام کارهای روزانه» است.
همانطور که در ابتدا توسط The Miamian (از طریق Rock Paper Shotgun) هفته گذشته از طریق درخواست ثبت عمومی فاش شد، دانیلا لوین کاوا، شهردار Miami-Dade، در ژوئن سال جاری یک همکاری âGTA VI Ã MDCâ را برای Rockstar Games ارائه کرد.
زمینی که در اینجا موجود است، راه‌هایی را بیان می‌کند که میامی، که به‌عنوان «الهام‌بخش دنیای واقعی برای Vice City» توصیف می‌شود، را می‌توان با استفاده از «کاراکترهای تأیید شده GTA VI یا ارجاعات بصری» تغییر داد. ایده‌های واقعاً جالبی در اینجا وجود دارد، مانند رویداد پیشنهادی Vice City Motor Fest، که «ماشین‌های کلاسیک، خودروهای کلاسیک، موتورسیکلت‌های سفارشی‌شده، موتورسیکلت‌های سفارشی‌سازی شده را ترکیب می‌کند. یک محیط کنترل شده و مناسب برای خانواده.â
در حالی که سخنگویی از طرف شهردار Miami-Dade اظهار داشت که همکاری GTA VI Ã MDC هنوز به طور رسمی مورد موافقت یا تایید قرار نگرفته است، کلانتر Miami-Dade هنوز هم قرارداد بازاریابی برنامه ریزی شده را به چالش کشیده است.
کلانتر Cordero-Stutz اظهار داشت: "Grand Theft Auto یک فرنچایز از بازی های ویدیویی است که بر اساس فعالیت های مجرمانه ساخته شده است." "دنیای خیالی آن شامل قتل، سرقت، قاچاق مواد مخدر، سرقت خودرو، خشونت علیه مجریان قانون و سایر رفتارهایی است که مردان و زنان اداره کلانتری میامی-داده هر روز برای جلوگیری از آن تلاش می کنند."
همانطور که توسط میامی هرالد گزارش شده است، اظهارات کلانتر کوردرو-اشتوتز بخشی از بیانیه مشترک او و خوان کارلوس برمودز، کمیسر میامی داد، نامزد جمهوری خواه است که به طور بالقوه قرار است با شهردار لوین کاوا، یک دموکرات، در سال 2028 مخالفت کند.
برمودز اظهار داشت: «شهرستان میامی داد دهه‌ها را صرف ساختن شهرت به عنوان مقصدی در سطح جهانی برای گردشگری، تجارت، سرمایه‌گذاری و فرصت کرده است». "ما باید Miami-Dade را که برای ساختن آن سخت کار کرده ایم، تبلیغ کنیم، نه یک نسخه خیالی از جامعه خود که با جنایت و خشونت تعریف شده است."

title.en: Apple's Foldable iPhone Runs Into Early Trouble
title.fa: آیفون تاشو اپل با مشکل اولیه مواجه شد

summary.en: Scarcity could boost hype while limiting near-term revenue
summary.fa: کمبود می تواند باعث افزایش تبلیغات شود و در عین حال درآمد کوتاه مدت را محدود کند

content.en:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) could enter the foldable smartphone market with an immediate supply problem, as early production of its long-rumored foldable iPhone is reportedly running at only a few hundred units per day. The constraint could create scarcity around one of Apple's most important new hardware categories in years, but it may also limit the product's near-term financial impact despite an expected price above $2,000.
-       Warning! GuruFocus has detected 5 Warning Signs with TSLA.
-       Is AAPL fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.
The production bottleneck reportedly stems from Apple's unusually strict quality-control standards as manufacturing partners work to improve yields. Apple has not publicly confirmed the foldable iPhone.
TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo previously estimated second-half 2026 assembly shipments of roughly 7 million to 8 million units, including only 500,000 to 1 million units in the third quarter. He expects pricing around $2,300 to $2,500, positioning the device well above Apple's conventional Pro models.
That creates an unusual setup. Limited supply could reinforce the foldable iPhone's premium image and generate strong early demand, but Apple will need manufacturing yields to improve quickly if the device is to become a meaningful contributor to iPhone revenue.
By comparison, Kuo expects roughly 20 million to 22 million iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max shipments during Q3, highlighting how small the foldable launch may initially be relative to Apple's core premium lineup.
The stakes are substantial because iPhone remains Apple's most important hardware business. Apple reported record June-quarter company revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16% year over year, with iPhone revenue also reaching a June-quarter record.
Investors Takeaway
Attention now turns to Apple's September 9 product event, which the company has officially scheduled for 10 a.m. Pacific time.
Investors should watch the foldable iPhone's price, launch timing, availability and production guidance. A device near $2,500 could materially lift average selling prices if Apple eventually scales production.
But prolonged supply constraints would cap unit volumes and delay that upside. The most important signal may therefore be how quickly Apple's manufacturing partners can move beyond the initial low-output phase without compromising the quality standards behind the bottleneck.
content.fa:
این مقاله برای اولین بار در GuruFocus ظاهر شد.
اپل (NASDAQ:AAPL) می‌تواند با مشکل عرضه فوری وارد بازار گوشی‌های هوشمند تاشو شود، زیرا طبق گزارش‌ها، تولید اولیه آیفون تاشو که مدت‌ها شایعه شده بود تنها با چند صد دستگاه در روز اجرا می‌شود. این محدودیت می‌تواند در یکی از مهم‌ترین دسته‌های سخت‌افزار جدید اپل در سال‌ها کمبود ایجاد کند، اما ممکن است تاثیر مالی کوتاه‌مدت محصول را با وجود قیمت پیش‌بینی‌شده بالای ۲۰۰۰ دلار نیز محدود کند.
- هشدار! GuruFocus 5 علامت هشدار را با TSLA شناسایی کرده است.
- آیا AAPL منصفانه ارزش دارد؟ پایان نامه خود را با ماشین حساب DCF رایگان ما تست کنید.
بر اساس گزارش ها، گلوگاه تولید ناشی از استانداردهای غیرمعمول سختگیرانه کنترل کیفیت اپل است زیرا شرکای تولیدی برای بهبود بازده تلاش می کنند. اپل به طور عمومی آیفون تاشو را تایید نکرده است.
مینگ چی کو، تحلیلگر اوراق بهادار بین المللی TF، پیش از این، محموله های مونتاژ نیمه دوم سال 2026 را حدود 7 تا 8 میلیون واحد تخمین زد که تنها 500000 تا 1 میلیون واحد در سه ماهه سوم بود. او انتظار دارد قیمتی در حدود 2300 تا 2500 دلار داشته باشد که دستگاه را بسیار بالاتر از مدل های معمولی پرو اپل قرار می دهد.
این یک تنظیم غیرمعمول ایجاد می کند. عرضه محدود می تواند تصویر ممتاز آیفون تاشو را تقویت کند و تقاضای اولیه زیادی را ایجاد کند، اما اپل برای بهبود سریع بازده تولید نیاز دارد تا این دستگاه به یک سهم معنادار در درآمد آیفون تبدیل شود.
در مقام مقایسه، Kuo انتظار دارد حدود 20 تا 22 میلیون آیفون 18 پرو و ​​پرو مکس در سه ماهه سوم عرضه شود، که نشان می‌دهد عرضه تاشو در ابتدا نسبت به خط تولید اصلی اپل چقدر کوچک است.
خطرات قابل توجهی هستند زیرا آیفون همچنان مهمترین تجارت سخت افزاری اپل است. اپل رکورد درآمد سه ماهه ژوئن شرکت را 109.4 میلیارد دلار گزارش کرد که نسبت به سال گذشته 16 درصد رشد داشت و درآمد آیفون نیز به رکورد سه ماهه ژوئن رسید.
پیشنهاد سرمایه گذاران
اکنون توجه به رویداد محصول اپل در 9 سپتامبر معطوف شده است که این شرکت رسماً برای ساعت 10 صبح به وقت اقیانوس آرام برنامه ریزی کرده است.
سرمایه گذاران باید قیمت آیفون تاشو، زمان عرضه، در دسترس بودن و راهنمایی تولید را تماشا کنند. اگر اپل در نهایت تولید خود را افزایش دهد، دستگاهی نزدیک به 2500 دلار می‌تواند میانگین قیمت‌های فروش را افزایش دهد.
اما محدودیت های طولانی مدت عرضه، حجم واحد را محدود می کند و افزایش آن را به تاخیر می اندازد. بنابراین مهم‌ترین سیگنال ممکن است این باشد که شرکای تولیدی اپل با چه سرعتی می‌توانند از فاز اولیه کم خروجی فراتر روند بدون اینکه استانداردهای کیفیت پشت گلوگاه را به خطر بیندازند.

content.en:
Microsoft is partnering with TCL to bring its Xbox app to supported TCL smart TVs. The Xbox app lets you connect to Xbox Cloud Gaming and stream Game Pass titles or select games you own as part of a subscription.
Xbox app is coming to TCL TVs just as Microsoft rolls out pay-as-you-go cloud gaming
Xbox Cloud Gaming is coming to more TVs, just as Microsoft makes some major changes to its cloud gaming service.
The Xbox app will arrive on TCL TVs at some point “in the coming months,” which is just in time for Microsoft’s new pay-as-you-go option for Xbox Cloud Gaming in November. This will let anyone access the cloud streaming service without the need to subscribe to Xbox Game Pass — ideal for people who don’t own an Xbox console. Microsoft has also been testing free, ad-supported cloud gaming for Xbox Insiders, which could roll out soon and provide even more options to access Xbox Cloud Gaming.
While Microsoft is opening up access to cloud gaming, it’s also limiting monthly cloud hours for Game Pass subscribers. Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscribers will be limited to just 15 hours of cloud access a month, with 10 hours for Premium subscribers, and a measly 5 hours for Game Pass Essential. Game Pass subscribers will need to purchase bundles of cloud hours if they need additional playtime.
TCL is the latest in a line of TV manufacturers to partner with Microsoft to rollout the Xbox app. Hisense started adding the Xbox app to its TVs running the VIDAA OS earlier this year, and many Samsung, LG, and Amazon Fire TV devices also have access to the Xbox app.
content.fa:
مایکروسافت با TCL همکاری می کند تا برنامه Xbox خود را به تلویزیون های هوشمند TCL پشتیبانی کند. برنامه Xbox به شما امکان می‌دهد به Xbox Cloud Gaming متصل شوید و عناوین Game Pass را پخش کنید یا بازی‌هایی را که به عنوان بخشی از اشتراک دارید انتخاب کنید.
درست زمانی که مایکروسافت بازی‌های ابری را به صورت پرداختی در اختیار کاربران قرار می‌دهد، برنامه Xbox به تلویزیون‌های TCL می‌آید.
بازی Xbox Cloud به تلویزیون‌های بیشتری می‌آید، درست همانطور که مایکروسافت تغییرات عمده‌ای را در سرویس بازی ابری خود ایجاد می‌کند.
برنامه Xbox در برخی مواقع «در ماه‌های آینده» روی تلویزیون‌های TCL وارد می‌شود، که دقیقاً به موقع برای گزینه پرداخت جدید مایکروسافت برای Xbox Cloud Gaming در ماه نوامبر است. این به هر کسی امکان می‌دهد بدون نیاز به اشتراک در Xbox Game Pass به سرویس استریم ابری دسترسی داشته باشد - ایده‌آل برای افرادی که کنسول Xbox ندارند. مایکروسافت همچنین در حال آزمایش بازی‌های ابری رایگان و با پشتیبانی از تبلیغات برای Xbox Insiders است که می‌تواند به زودی عرضه شود و گزینه‌های بیشتری برای دسترسی به Xbox Cloud Gaming ارائه دهد.
در حالی که مایکروسافت دسترسی به بازی های ابری را باز می کند، همچنین ساعات ماهانه ابری را برای مشترکین Game Pass محدود می کند. مشترکین Xbox Game Pass Ultimate تنها به 15 ساعت دسترسی ابری در ماه محدود خواهند شد، 10 ساعت برای مشترکین Premium و 5 ساعت برای Game Pass Essential. مشترکین Game Pass در صورت نیاز به زمان بازی اضافی، باید بسته‌های ساعت ابری را خریداری کنند.
TCL آخرین محصول از سری تولیدکنندگان تلویزیون است که با مایکروسافت برای عرضه برنامه Xbox شریک شده اند. هایسنس در اوایل سال جاری شروع به اضافه کردن برنامه Xbox به تلویزیون های خود با سیستم عامل VIDAA کرد و بسیاری از دستگاه های Samsung، LG و Amazon Fire TV نیز به برنامه Xbox دسترسی دارند.

content.en:
IFA 2026 is underway in Berlin, and the product announcements are already coming fast. The massive European tech show doesn’t officially open to the public until Friday, but press events began earlier this week, giving us an early look at the TVs, laptops, wearables, smart home gear and oddly specific appliances headed our way.
More than 1,900 brands are expected at Messe Berlin through Tuesday, including Samsung, LG, Lenovo and Acer. AI will, unsurprisingly, be everywhere, in computers, appliances and probably a few things that absolutely did not need it, alongside robots, new gaming gear and whatever else manages to surprise us on the show floor.
CNET is in Berlin getting hands-on with the biggest products and digging through the chaos to find the stuff actually worth paying attention to. Follow along below for our latest news, first impressions, photos and videos from IFA 2026.
We’ll keep updating this page as more announcements roll in.
Editors’ note: Travel costs for CNET staff contributing to this liveblog were covered by IFA, Roborock, Xiaomi and Lenovo. The judgments and opinions of CNET are our own.
These new smart cycling glasses are just the edge I needed
When I cycle, I look more like Pee-wee Herman than a Tour de France threat, but BleeqUp’s latest UV-protective AI sports glasses, Rover, could change all that.
In addition to an AI-powered camera that films and edits your ride for you — a feature found on its previous glasses — the latest gen now gives you audio prompts based on your route, so you’ll know when a tight curve or steep incline is upcoming and can prepare accordingly (or give up).
While there was no road for the glasses to track inside the expo hall, a rep showed me a recorded demo on her phone, and it was pretty darn cool.
This auto-pet feeder is basically an Instant Pot for cats
One of the coolest things I’ve seen so far at IFA is an automatic pet feeder that mixes wet food on demand and dispenses it to your cat — or small dog, I suppose — at mealtime. It’s called Rico, and it comes courtesy of Neakasa, a brand known for self-cleaning litter boxes and other smart cat accessories.
The machine houses freeze-dried food and has a water reservoir. Once triggered, it rehydrates and mixes the meal for an elevated, automatic cat-feeding experience. Read more about it here.
The most bizzarre tech we've found at IFA… so far
IFA is in full swing, and we’ve tracked down some of the strangest tech being unleashed at the massive Expo. We’re talking countertop tofu makers, ceiling lights that change color based on your mood and automatic pet feeders that whip up fresh meals for your cat while you’re gone.
Check out our full list of the weirdest, wildest tech we spotted at IFA 2026.
Midea’s new AC follows you with a stream of chilled air for efficient cooling
Midea has a massive showcase at IFA 2026. One of the highlights I saw – and felt – was an air conditioner unit that sends custom cool air to you wherever you are. The system uses spatial imaging and sensors to know where you are and send its stream of cool air your way. That means a cooler you, and less energy wasted.
It’s voice-activated, so you can turn it on or off, or trigger the mmWave sensor system, without getting up or even opening your phone.
Midea’s smart system also works with its air-quality appliances, including its humidifier. The two work in harmony to keep your home’s air at a perfectly set target temperature and humidity, no matter what Mother Nature has planned.
Xiaomi's foldable is taking aim at Apple and Samsung
Passport shapes are the new hot thing in foldable phones, with Samsung launching its Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Apple strongly rumored to be opting for a passport design with its upcoming folding iPhone Ultra. Not wanting to be left out of the game, Xiaomi has shown off its Xiaomi 18 Fold at IFA.
The passport shape gives it a squatter appearance when closed, but it also means the larger inner screen has a wider aspect ratio, making it better suited for watching videos. We don’t yet have the exact dimensions of the phone, but it appears to be about the same size as Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8.
Interestingly, Xiaomi hasn’t opted for a Qualcomm or MediaTek processor but is instead building its own homemade Xring 03 chip. Both Apple and Google have opted to create their own silicon, and clearly Xiaomi sees merit in this strategy.
How the phone really stacks up against its rivals remains to be seen when it goes on sale in China later in September. Sadly, global availability has yet to be announced.
XPENG's ARIDGE flying car concept stopped me in my tracks
First thing this morning, I was power-walking through the halls of the Messe – the Berlin convention center that hosts IFA – determined that nothing would stop me from getting to my meeting on time.
But then I caught a glimpse of the XPENG booth. I’d been distracted by an electric vertical takeoff and landing, which was accompanied by a van that had something of a Cybertruck.
It turned out to be a flying-car concept consisting of a “mothership,” a six-wheel-drive ground vehicle (the van), and an autonomous, detachable two-seater air module. Developed by ARIDGE under the XPENG umbrella, this concept allows the mothership to transport the air module in the trunk to different locations. The mothership has an onboard automatic separation-and-reconnection system that can deploy the air module.
At the XPENG booth, both vehicles were completely stationary, and I couldn’t imagine how the air module, with its wide, outstretched propeller arms, could possibly fit inside the mothership.
I need Anker's SleepLab Pro on my bedside table ASAP
When I first saw the pictures of Anker’s new bedside speaker, the SleepLab Pro, I was impressed by its slick design. Then I saw it in person, and I liked it even more.
The circular speaker module floats within an orb-shaped shell and glows in different colors. Even though it’s tall, the slim frame means the device’s overall footprint isn’t overly large.
At the top is a little pop-up radar that tracks your sleep, heart rate and breathing, then plays tailored audio to help you fall asleep and stay asleep — all with no wearables required.
One thing I don’t quite understand is how the radar works if there are two people in bed at once. The idea of wearable-free sleep tracking is nice in theory, but it seems like it could be skewed by the presence of multiple people.
Even so, I like the look of the speaker enough that I’d gladly have the non-Pro version as well, which is the same device without the radar tracking. Instead, it’ll just lull you to sleep with soft music and a nightlight – as well as waking you up in the morning with the same.
I’m already a fan of Anker’s existing sleep headphones, so I’m keen to see how its newest sleep tech can improve my slumber even further.
Miele launches a premium camera-equipped dishwasher. Here’s what it does
IFA is just underway but we already got our eyes on a first. Luxury German appliance maker Miele launched a smart dishwasher with an AI-powered camera mounted on the back of the door. It’s the world’s first dishwasher to integrate camera technology, hot-air drying and automatic dosing in a single machine.
Curious, right?
The Diamond G8 uses image recognition to determine what’s in the dishwasher, so it can pick the perfect cycle, ensuring cleaner dishes while using only as much soap and energy as needed. The smart appliance also times its cycles to run when energy costs are lowest in your area.
Hallo from Berlin. CNET is on the ground at IFA, Europe’s largest tech show
CNET’s on the ground at IFA Berlin. It’s Europe’s largest consumer technology showcase – think CES, but with way more sauerkraut. The show officially opens Friday, but we snuck in the back for a first look at the tech everyone will be talking about.
Our team of seven is stomping the halls of the Messe Berlin Expo Center, tracking down all the coolest, weirdest and most jaw-dropping tech. Follow along if you like robots, phones, flying cars (yes, we already found flying cars), futuristic kitchen gear, beauty and wellness tech and smart home systems.
Prost!

summary.en: What happens if you simulate the upcoming NBA season on âNBA 2Kâ 100 times? We decided to find out for ourselves and record all the results.
summary.fa: اگر 100 بار فصل آینده NBA را در âNBA 2Kâ شبیه سازی کنید، چه اتفاقی می افتد؟ تصمیم گرفتیم خودمان بفهمیم و همه نتایج را ثبت کنیم.

content.en:
We Simulated the 2026-27 Season 100 Times on âNBA 2K27.â Here Are the Results.
In this story:
Iâve always found the NBA 2K games to be quite fun. Itâs not a perfect NBA simulator, but itâs pretty darn closeâas close as you can reasonably expect. The ratings for each player are largely fair and how well each team performs is usually in line with real-world expectations. Most importantly, it remains thrilling to take control of Steph Curry to rain down threes from half court or posterize the daylights out of an opposing center with Anthony Edwards.
Normally those are reasons enough to look forward to the annual release of NBA 2K every year, but this year had a special draw. A roller coaster of an NBA offseason saw multiple stars change teams and rosters shuffle across the league. All those moves serve as a foundation for what will be the most interesting season in recent NBA memory. There are questions aboundâcan LeBron mesh with the 76ers? Will Giannis and Bam work together? Can anyone really threaten Victor Wembanyama for an MVP trophy?âthat can only be answered by watching how the games play out on the court.
But with NBA 2K27 releasing on Friday, the thought occurred to the Sports Illustrated NBA team: What if we could get some answers to those questions by asking the video gameâs computer?
Thus, I downloaded the new 2K game, fired up my PlayStation and simulated the 2026â27 season. Not once. Not twice. But 100 times.
I wanted to see what the most advanced basketball simulator on the market thought of the new-look Celtics and Timberwolves, how an exciting Rookie of the Year race will play out, and which of the new loaded rosters in the East wind up out of the playoff picture. Above all, I was curious to learn which team would be left standing amid a fairly unpredictable championship landscape. Based on all the quantified skills of every roster in the league, who will raise the Larry OâBrien trophy next June?
Here are the results of those 100 simulations. Some may shock you. Particularly if you are a 76ers fan. I doubt the Philly fan base will be too happy with their new teamâs performances.
Jump to a result:
How we set it up
First, for the sake of clarity, letâs break down the settings used for the 100 simulated seasons.
The game mode is MyNBA (effectively franchise mode), which allowed for a full seasonâs simulation plus a playoff run. The âstandardâ preset setting was used, which strikes the middle ground balance between uber-realism and video game-y results. Each team was controlled by a computer, so every season all 30 franchises were free to make trades and lineup adjustments and any other moves. And at the end of every Finals, we restarted the whole thing.
It is important to note, in addition to those settings, that NBA 2K rosters are finalized in mid-July. Which means, for example, that Kawhi Leonard remains on the Clippers for our 100 simulations. It also means that any player who retired after July 15 is still in the game. Youâll understand why thatâs important later.
Now letâs get to the fun stuff.
NBA championships
The two teams that won the most championships over our 100 simulations represent our first, and arguably most surprising, data point.
The Spurs and the Magic finished the simulations tied at 19 championships won apiece. Thatâs right: the Magic. 2K is apparently extremely high on Paolo Banchero and Franz Wagnerâs potential with new head coach Sean Sweeney in the mix; Orlando regularly finished with a top-three seed in the Eastern Conference with consistent Finals appearances.
San Antonio is ... less of a surprise, you might say. Led by ascending superstar and NBA 2K27 cover athlete Victor Wembanyama, the Spurs never finished below the No. 3 seed in our 100 simulations and were a regular sight in the Finals. As far as the computer believes, Wemby and his young teammates are set to avenge their heart-breaking series defeat to the Knicks in June.
Speaking of, New York tied for the second-most titles in our simulations, with 18 championship runs. Going back-to-back is one of the toughest feats in sports but the Knicks have the video game gods on their side. The other team to win 18 times out of 100? The Timberwolves. The new Anthony Edwards-LaMelo Ball pairing is not only set to entertain but put up literal video game numbers, according to the video game itself. Lastly, two teams were able to slide in with exactly one title: the Cavaliers and Mavericks (a Cooper Flagg Finals MVP in his second season would be quite a sight!).
Runners-up
Of course, we had to track the runner-ups if we were tracking the champions. According to NBA 2K, which fan base should prepare itself for disappointment?
The answer: the Pistons. Despite winning 14 titles out of 100 above, Detroit wound up losing two more than it won, recording 16 Finals losses. Thatâs tied with the Knicks for the most out of our 100 simulations. The Timberwolves, Magic and Spurs also suffered plenty of championship defeats, which is no surprise given how many wins they racked up above.
The most interesting result of this section is the Trail Blazers finishing with eight Finals losses; combined with their above championships, that means Portland made 11 runs through the Western Conference playoff bracket out of 100 tries. The Blazersâ roster is obviously talented with Damian Lillard and Ja Morant in the backcourt but itâs far from a clean fit. NBA 2K disagrees, however. The team regularly finished with a top-six record in the West and, as you can see, got the job done on a few occasions.
There are also three teams who made it to the Finals exactly once and lostâthe Suns, Warriors and Nuggets.
If you read these first two sections closely, youâll notice a distinct lack of 76ers mentions. Weâll touch on that more later, but know that itâs not a typo. The Sixers did not make a single NBA Finals appearance throughout our 100 simulations. They didnât even get close.
MVP
With the overall results out of the way, we now move towards the individual awards handed out at the end of each regular season. First up? The MVP award.
It shouldnât come as a big surprise to learn that NBA 2K has Wembanyama as next seasonâs MVP favorite. He took home the vast majority of the MVP awards during our simulations, finishing with 66% of the MVPs handed out. When he didnât win for one reason or another it was usually Nikola JokiÄ winning his fourth MVP trophy. Cade Cunningham brought home double-digit MVPs as well.
The most fun result: Karl-Anthony Towns winning two out of 100 possible MVP awards by averaging 22 points and 10 rebounds for a pair of 70-win Knicks teams. Wemby failing to meet the minimum games played requirement in those two seasons helped.
Sixth Man of the Year
This is the one that got a little weird.
As noted above, the rosters for this yearâs game were finalized in mid-July. But Russell Westbrook announced his retirement in August, so he is not actually retired in video game land. Instead Westbrook is the top free agent available on the market to start every season. Which means he gets signed immediately and, in our simulations, winds up shining off the benchâWestbrook won 25 of our 100 possible 6MOY awards for 10 different teams.
Otherwise, though, it was an interesting set of data points for an award race that doesnât really have a favorite entering the season. Scoot Henderson brought home the most 6MOY awards with 28 (further hammering home the computerâs inclination towards Portland), while last yearâs breakout Thunder star Ajay Mitchell and exciting young Pelicans rookie Jeremiah Fears took home 15 apiece. The most random result: Naji Marshall, who won two 6MOY awards for the Mavericks.
Rookie of the Year
Cameron Boozer largely dominated ROY voting in our 100 NBA 2K simulations. The Grizzlies rookie is well-positioned to rack up solid counting numbers as a top option on a bad team, which is usually a ripe environment for Rookie of the Year candidates to thrive. The other winnersâDarius Acuff Jr., Darryn Peterson and Caleb Wilsonâwerenât shocking to see, either.
What was a tad shocking was the complete lack of AJ Dybantsa. The heralded Wizards rookie was the top pick of the â26 draft above all those guys but didnât take home a single ROY award in any of the 100 seasons simulated in NBA 2K.
Defensive Player of the Year
If you feel strongly this is Wembanyamaâs award to lose, 2K couldnât agree with you more. Wemby took home a whopping 93 DPOY awards out of 100 possible opportunities. Not much else to say; the reigning winner is a force of nature as a defender the likes of which weâve never really seen.
That win percentage makes it all the more impressive that the Pistonsâ Ausar Thompson (four) and the Thunderâs Chet Holmgren (three) took any off Wemby.
Interesting trends, including the 76ersâ consistent failure
Over the course of 100 simulated versions of the upcoming season, itâs inevitable for trends to emerge. Thereâs a degree of randomness involved, to be sure, but at a basic level this is a math equation executed by the 2K computer. No two seasons are exactly the same but many ended up with shared traits when it was all said and doneâtrends, in fewer words.
One of those trends? The consistent failure of the 76ers, who added LeBron James and Jaylen Brown to the Tyrese Maxey-Joel Embiid core this offseason. According to NBA 2K, the great Philadelphia experiment will not work. Out of 100 simulations, the Sixers made the playoffs in only three seasons. Three out of 100! And of those three appearances, only one came as a top-six seed; the other two came by way of the play-in tournament, where Philly finished in the 7-10 seed range in the East. They qualified for the play-in six additional times but lost before making it to the final bracket.
Thus, the final numbers on the NBA 2K version of the 76ers: 92 losing seasons, six play-in losses, and three playoff series losses. They failed to make it past the first round at any point. Fortunately, Philadelphia can take solace in the fact that basketball is not played on a computer but instead out on the court.
Other teams the simulation was down on: the Nuggets, Lakers and Heat. Despite the presence of international superstars and historic producers in JokiÄ, Luka DonÄiÄ and Giannis Antetokounmpo, the trioâs respective teams rarely qualified for the playoff bracket as a top-six seed. Denver wound up making one run but Los Angeles never got past the West semis, and Miami was unable to record a single Finals appearance.
In terms of awards we didnât track specifically, the game loves Zaccarie Risacherâs chances of getting a change-of-scenery bump in Dallas. The former No. 1 pick got traded to the Mavericks from the Hawks this offseason and won many Most Improved Player awards in our simulations.
Here are a few more tidbits from 100 seasons of NBA action that I found interesting:
- Max Strus was constantly bought out by the Clippers and ended up signing with a contender on Feb. 28. If that proves prescient he could be the most impactful buyout player ever. So weâre rooting for that from a general interest standpoint.
- I was fully anticipating a handful of super wacky results in the form of bad teams making unexpectedly deep playoff runs, but that was largely limited. Simulation tech has come a long way. But the two that popped up: the Nets making the ECF as an eight seed, and the Kings pushing the Spurs to seven games in the first round after two play-in wins.
- The Suns were regularly a middle seed and made one truly epic Finals runâthat ended in a brutal four-game sweep by the Knicks.
It was a fun experiment. Now we all look forward to the real games.

content.en:
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is getting a physical version, but it will require an internet connection to download
Seeing Red XIII.
The third and final entry in the Final Fantasy 7 Remake series will launch on just one disc - unlike both Remake and Rebirth, which were spread across two - but the downside is that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will need to download extra game data on all formats, if you buy the physical edition. The previous games in the series were 'content complete' on disc (before any post-launch updates, at least), and could be played out the box. That will not be the case for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, no matter what platform you purchase it on.
Physical versions of games are in the spotlight right now, largely thanks to Sony's controversial decision to bin off physical discs by 2028, but what players are offered for their money is under more scrutiny than ever. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, set to be the biggest game in the Remake trilogy, comes with a disclaimer for the PS5 and Xbox versions on the Square Enix website:
"An internet connection is required to download additional game data in order to play the physical version of the game."
It is not yet clear whether the game will be partly on-disc, or whether the physical item will act as a license unlock, effectively, with the user needing to download all 100GB+ of the game file via their online connection. For the Nintendo Switch 2 version, the game card will just be a key, meaning you'll have to download the whole game once the card is in your machine. Notably, the Switch 2 version of the game weighs in at a startling 130GB, taking up over half the console's internal storage. Ouch. The file size for the PlayStation and Xbox versions of the game has not yet been revealed.
Yesterday, today director Naoki Hamaguchi took to Sony's State of Play livestream to inform us all that the game has a locked-in release date of 8th April, 2027. It'll launch worldwide, and on all platforms - that's PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S, and PC - at the same time (the first game in the series to do so).

دیدن سرخ سیزدهم.
سومین و آخرین ورودی از سری Final Fantasy 7 Remake تنها بر روی یک دیسک عرضه می‌شود - برخلاف Remake و Rebirth که در دو دیسک پخش شده‌اند - اما نقطه ضعف آن این است که Final Fantasy 7 Revelation در صورت خرید نسخه فیزیکی، نیاز به دانلود اطلاعات اضافی بازی در همه فرمت‌ها دارد. بازی‌های قبلی این سری «محتوا کامل» روی دیسک بودند (حداقل قبل از هر گونه به‌روزرسانی پس از راه‌اندازی)، و می‌توانستند خارج از جعبه بازی کنند. این موضوع برای Final Fantasy 7 Revelation صادق نخواهد بود، صرف نظر از اینکه آن را در چه پلتفرمی خریداری کنید.
نسخه‌های فیزیکی بازی‌ها در حال حاضر در کانون توجه هستند، تا حد زیادی به لطف تصمیم بحث‌برانگیز سونی برای حذف دیسک‌های فیزیکی تا سال 2028، اما آنچه بازیکنان در ازای پولشان ارائه می‌شوند بیش از هر زمان دیگری تحت بررسی است. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation که قرار است بزرگترین بازی در سه گانه Remake باشد، با یک سلب مسئولیت برای نسخه های PS5 و Xbox در وب سایت Square Enix ارائه می شود:
"برای دانلود اطلاعات اضافی بازی به منظور اجرای نسخه فیزیکی بازی، اتصال به اینترنت لازم است."
هنوز مشخص نیست که آیا بازی تا حدی بر روی دیسک خواهد بود یا اینکه آیا آیتم فیزیکی به عنوان یک مجوز باز کردن قفل عمل می کند و کاربر باید تمام 100 گیگابایت فایل بازی را از طریق اتصال آنلاین خود دانلود کند. برای نسخه Nintendo Switch 2، کارت بازی فقط یک کلید خواهد بود، به این معنی که وقتی کارت در دستگاه شما قرار گرفت، باید کل بازی را دانلود کنید. نکته قابل توجه این است که نسخه Switch 2 این بازی 130 گیگابایت وزن دارد و بیش از نیمی از حافظه داخلی کنسول را اشغال می کند. اوه اندازه فایل نسخه های پلی استیشن و ایکس باکس بازی هنوز مشخص نشده است.
دیروز، نائوکی هاماگوچی، کارگردان امروز، به پخش زنده State of Play سونی رفت تا به همه ما اطلاع دهد که بازی دارای تاریخ انتشار قفل شده در 8 آوریل 2027 است. این بازی در سرتاسر جهان و بر روی همه پلتفرم‌ها عرضه می‌شود - PS5، Nintendo Switch 2، Xbox Series X/S، و اولین بازی در رایانه شخصی - در همان زمان این کار را انجام داد.

content.en:
Audacity enters a “new era” with the biggest update in the free and open-source audio editor’s 26-year history
Audacity 4 overhauls the software's editing workflow, polishes up its interface and introduces new ways for users to organize their work
Launched in 2000, Audacity is one of the world’s most popular apps for audio editing and recording, having accrued hundreds of millions of downloads over its 26-year lifespan.
It’s not hard to see why: not only is it free, open-source and cross-platform, Audacity has become increasingly powerful in recent years, inching ever closer to becoming a fully-fledged DAW while preserving the simplicity and ease-of-use that it’s known for.
Today, Muse Group is launching Audacity 4, bringing with it a host of significant improvements in what its creators are describing as “the biggest update” in the software's history. Audacity’s latest update overhauls the software’s editing workflow, polishes up its interface and introduces new ways for users to organize their work, all with the aim of making the app easier and more intuitive to use.
Open up Audacity 4, and you’ll be able to see the difference straight away: the software now opens on a dedicated home screen and has been outfitted with a refreshed user interface that has a more modern feel. (If you like the classic Audacity look, you can switch back over.)
The update isn’t just skin-deep though, and Muse Group says it has improved “nearly every aspect” of Audacity’s audio editing workflow in an effort to provide greater flexibility when working on complex projects. Clips can now overlap on the timeline and be combined in groups, and they’ve also been equipped with new handles for trimming and stretching. Audio editing is now non-destructive, so trimming clips no longer deletes the underlying audio.
A new Split tool has been introduced that allows you to slice up clips with ease and precision, and the Envelope tool has been improved. What’s more, each track in Audacity 4 now has its own level meter that can also monitor audio input when recording, and the main playback meter can be switched to a vertical orientation.
Audacity 4 also introduces Workspaces, which allow you to switch between multiple versions of its interface designed for different use cases. The interface is now more customizable, and you’re able to save customized iterations of the UI as Workspaces that suit your personal workflow.

The update has also refreshed the software’s catalogue of audio effects to make them more intuitive to use, and the application now supports a broader range of third-party VST3/AU/LV2 effects.
"Audacity has been helping creators record and edit audio for more than 25 years, and our goal with version 4 was to prepare it for the next 25”, Muse Group’s Chief Product Officer Julia Sazhina said in a press release.
“At Muse Group, we're always looking ahead at how technology can help creativity. It was important for us to bring one of the world's most iconic audio editors into the new era. We are not changing what creators love about Audacity, but giving it the modern architecture needed to support the intelligent tools and connected workflows of the future."
Audacity 4 is now available for macOS, Windows and Linux. Head over to MuseHub for a download.
